integrity: Full analytic reduction and strict-equality argument are given. A standalone symbolic/finite diagnostic is supplementary and is not treated as proof of infinite parameter families. Literature-priority uncertainty is expressly retained.
limitations: Real two-dimensional quartic norm only. The strict comparison is global in positive weights but does not determine the exact restricted constant at arbitrary weights. The asymptotic and unique-orbit assertions hold only locally as weight tends to zero. The known unrestricted value and the leading skew residual are credited; no independent audit or publication-priority guarantee is asserted.
title: Birkhoff restriction creates a sharp skew-mean gap in real \(\ell_4^2\)
